name: Recital R
title: REPORT on the annual report on the activities of the European Ombudsman in 2024
part_text: whereas the Ombudsman examined the continued use of corporate sponsorships by the rotating Presidencyof the Council, as this practice has given rise to public disquiet regarding the potential influence that sponsors might be exerting on the EU decision-making process, particularly on deliberations concerning EU policy and legislation affecting such sponsors;
